svg.title: Gas Heaven (tiles v001) — collision layout
svg.desc: North is up. Coordinates in meters. Dark shapes block sight and movement; gray shapes block movement only. Windows and pallets occupy gaps. Grid spacing is eight meters.
svg.text: Gas Heaven (tiles v001) · 104 × 96 m · 1 tile = 8 m
9408 m² · 15 pallets · 15 windows · 11 generator candidates · 19 hooks · max hook walk 26 m
